runningPayloadBasis: Bumpers 6.0-7.5 kg, battery and leads 5.0-6.9 kg and 24 FUEL at 0.203-0.227 kg: all carried in the match but outside the R103 weighing

masses.basis: Four 2x1x0.125 in 6061 rails (2.72 m at 1.20 kg/m), 3 mm polycarbonate floor (about 0.4 m2), lip, slide rails, tube mounts, gussets
Four 2 mm polycarbonate panels (about 2.5 kg at 1.2 g/cm3) plus edge stiffeners
Four MAXSwerve corners: 1.720 kg purchased assembly each (foundation reconciliation) plus drive and steering motors
Two flat belt runs, rollers, one reversible motor and gearbox. The belt cleat of the earlier issue is removed; its mass was inside this range and the range is kept

Flywheel with 0.006 kg m2 on a 50.8 mm radius: 2.74-3.58 kg (a tube with 85% to 65% of its mass at the rim; I / r2 is the floor). Two 6 mm aluminum side plates 3.06 kg as drawn, 60% of that if lightened. Hood 0.75 kg. Two flywheel motors 0.9-1.2 kg. Shaft, bearings and fasteners 0.3-0.6 kg
Vertical belt module with internal motor, top roller, carriage plates and slide moving stage
Two telescoping tube pairs, hooks with swing actuators inside the inner tubes, winch and cables
Power distribution, controller, radio, 15 motor controllers, breaker, sensors, wiring on two side panels
R103 excludes bumpers; 6.0-7.5 kg carried in the running payload and in the R408 check
R103 excludes the battery and its connector half; 5.0-6.9 kg (V0 battery 4.99-6.57 kg plus leads) carried in the running payload
HUB and TOWER references are field equipment
Fasteners, brackets, cable chain, camera and spares not yet drawn
Two cleat envelopes, 74.5 cm3: high as solid 6061 at 2.70 g/cm3, low at half fill for formed angle; rivets inside

The 1516 W friction peak during a shot is drawn from the wheel's inertia
